evil-twin-random-event-trying-to-walk-th.npc: Wait! Do you know what you're doing here?

steps.player: Yes, I know, I've been here before.

steps.npc: Well, come on over and I'll fill you in on what happened.

evil-twin-random-event-talking-to-her-af.npc: It's my evil twin sister! She's been galavanting around Gielinor committing crimes and now I'm getting the blame!

evil-twin-random-event-talking-to-her-af.player: Well what's all this got to do with me then?

evil-twin-random-event-talking-to-her-af.npc: Through that door is a room with a cage and a control panel that operates a giant mechanical claw.
I lured my sister into the room so I could imprison her in the cage by using the claw. The problem is my sister managed to herd some innocent civilians in there with her.

evil-twin-random-event-talking-to-her-af.player: So what do you need me to do?

evil-twin-random-event-talking-to-her-af.npc: I need you to go next door and use the claw to catch my sister.
Once she's in prison, she won't be causing me anymore bother!
Fabulous! Now take a good long look at me because the door will be locked behind you. My twin looks exactly like me, even her clothes!
One more thing to make your life difficult; the magic powering the claw is running low so you'll only have two attempts to catch her.
By the way, would you like me to run through the controls for you, or do you think you'll manage?

steps.player: Yes please. I mean, it's always best to be prepared, right?

steps.npc: Ok, when you turn the machine on you'll see the glowing mark on the floor where the claw is currently aiming, and you'll see a lever and button on the right hand side of your screen.
To move the claw's current location, click on the direction you want it to move in, as indicated on the right hand panel.
You'll know which way the claw will go as the lever will point that way to show you.
When you see someone on top of the glowing mark, then hit the button on the right hand panel, as this will send the claw down to pick them up.
Do be careful and make sure that there is someone on the mark, and not just walking past it.
Oh, and make sure that the person is my sister, so you don't end up catching a random civilian.

steps.player: No, thanks. I should be able to work it out.

steps.npc: Fine. And there I was thinking you'd help.

steps.text: The player is teleported back to their initial location

evil-twin-random-event-clicking-grab-on-.npc: You need to use the control panel to use the claw!

evil-twin-random-event-after-grabbing-tw.npc: Well, you tried your best I suppose. Come next door and talk to me.

evil-twin-random-event-after-grabbing-tw.player: Err, sorry. I seem to have messed it up a little.

evil-twin-random-event-after-grabbing-tw.npc: Such incompetence! I should never have asked a baboon like you to do a complex task like this!

evil-twin-random-event-after-grabbing-tw.text: The player is teleported to one of the teleportation locations

evil-twin-random-event-after-grabbing-th.npc: Well done! You managed to catch my sister!
Come next door and talk to me.

evil-twin-random-event-after-grabbing-th.player: Well, I've managed to get her into the cage.

evil-twin-random-event-after-grabbing-th.npc: Fantastic! For so many years I've had to put up with her and now she's locked up for good.
Thank you for all your help. Take this as a reward.
